query_analysis.original_query: Retrieve the standard vapor pressure correction factors for different crude oil compositions in vacuum distillation processes.
query_analysis.expanded_query: Obtain the standard vapor pressure correction factors applicable to various crude oil compositions to adjust vapor pressure data during vacuum distillation process design and optimization.

clarification_questions: Are there specific crude oil compositions or types you are focusing on?
